description: This file defines a middleware class 'AuthSelectionMiddleware' responsible for handling authentication scheme resolution within the AWS SDK. It manages the selection of an appropriate auth scheme based on service and operation metadata, and applies the signature version to commands during request building.

classes.name: AuthSelectionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for selecting and applying the appropriate AWS authentication scheme during request processing.

methods.name: AuthSelectionMiddleware::wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a middleware wrapper function with specified auth resolver and API service.

methods.name: AuthSelectionMiddleware::__construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler, auth resolver, and service API.

methods.name: AuthSelectionMiddleware::__invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to resolve and set the authentication scheme for a command before passing control to the next handler.
